description_en: Retrieves a list of data transfer plans
kebab_example: aliyun cc5g list-data-packages --wireless-cloud-connector-id cc5g-xxxx --statuses Available --data-package-ids dp-xxxx --names cciot-123 --next-token iou001238joojjaere --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataPackages

parameters.help_en: ID of the 5G high-speed cloud instance
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: List of data transfer plan statuses
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: IDs of data transfer plans. Maximum: 20
parameters.name: data_package_ids

parameters.help_en: Names of data transfer plans. Maximum: 20
parameters.name: names

parameters.help_en: Value returned by the previous paged query. Do not specify this parameter for the first page
parameters.help_zh: 上一页的查询返回的值，首页查询不传值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum: 50. Default: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results
